description:
Search UNII (Unique Ingredient Identifiers) — links ingredient names to unique chemical IDs.

Example searches:
- 'unii:"L7V4I673D2"' — by UNII code
- 'substance_name:"ASPIRIN"' — by substance name

search.description: OpenFDA search query. Examples: 'field:value', 'field:"Exact Phrase"', 'field:[20200101+TO+20231231]', '_exists_:field'. Combine with '+AND+', '+OR+', '+NOT+'.

name: fda_unii
